name: nong-toolkit
description: Nong.Toolkit.Net — Claude Code multi-skill plugin for Nong.Cli.Net v12.1.0. 22 installable skills cover pure .NET document work, unified nong.db workflows, AMiner, Metaso, agricultural paper inspection, Office formats, OCR, export (EPUB/LaTeX/HTML/ODF), Markdown↔NongMark, workspace management, semantic search, slices, skill lifecycle, and Bioicons.
